description: Update an existing Data Store Finding in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_data_store_finding afterwards to see the updated record.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Data Store Finding to update. Required. Use list_data_store_findings to find IDs.

isConfirmed.description: A person confirmed the finding holds this data. A confirmed finding counts as High confidence toward the store's sensitivity and checks, whatever the scan or OneUptime AI was sure of.

isSuppressed.description: A person marked the finding as not sensitive. It no longer counts toward the store's sensitivity or checks.

suppressedReason.description: Why the finding was marked not sensitive.
suppressedReason.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

name: update_data_store_finding
title: Update Data Store Finding
